units.name: Center for Operations Research and Econometrics (CORE)
units.school: Louvain Institute of Data Analysis and Modeling in economics and statistics
units.evidence: Official center overview gives full name and acronym, explicitly places CORE within LIDAM rather than Louvain School of Management, and names operations research, mathematical optimization and supply chain management.

units.name: Mathematical Engineering department (INMA)
units.school: Institute of Information and Communication Technologies, Electronics and Applied Mathematics
units.evidence: Official page explicitly calls INMA the Mathematical Engineering department, gives parent ICTEAM institute and names operations research and optimization among its research fields.

decisions.reason: Center name verified, but official hierarchy is LIDAM research institute, not imported business-school parent; center retained as center.
